title: Spectrum Ring
description: Render a circular HSV color wheel in normalized [-1, 1] space. The hue is determined by the angle around the center, saturation by the distance from the center, and value is always 1.0. Clip the wheel to a hard edge at radius 0.9 — outside should be black.
hintText: Use atan(uv.y, uv.x) to get the angle and length(uv) for the radius. Map the angle to a hue in [0, 1] by dividing by 2*PI and offsetting by 0.5. Then implement HSV to RGB conversion: the hue selects which pair of channels to interpolate between.
